description: This file contains functions related to managing caching, metadata extraction, and compilation of operations in PyTorch's AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) eager mode, particularly for the '_inductor' component.

methods.name: Path aoti_eager_cache_dir(namespace: str, device: str)
methods.description: Returns the cache directory path for AOTI eager mode for a given namespace and device.

methods.name: Any aoti_eager_op_conf_lock(op_func_name_with_overload: str)
methods.description: Returns a file lock object for synchronizing access to operation configuration files.

methods.name: list[Optional[dict[str,Any]]] load_aoti_eager_cache( ns: str, op_func_name_with_overload: str, device_type: str )
methods.description: Loads cached kernel configuration data for a specific operation, namespace, and device, returning parsed metadata if available.

methods.name: dict[type,torch.dtype] supported_builtin_dtype_torch_dtype()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping Python built-in types to corresponding torch data types.

methods.name: tuple[type,...] supported_scalar_types()
methods.description: Returns a tuple of supported scalar Python types.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_tensor_metadata(dynamic: bool, input: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Extracts metadata from a torch.Tensor object, including device, dtype, shape, stride, etc.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_tensor_list_metadata( dynamic: bool, input: list[torch.Tensor], )
methods.description: Extracts metadata from a list of torch.Tensor objects.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_scalar_metadata(device_type: str, input: Any)
methods.description: Extracts metadata from scalar values like int, float, bool.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_string_metadata(input: str)
methods.description: Creates metadata dictionary for string input.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_dtype_metadata(input: torch.dtype)
methods.description: Creates metadata dictionary for torch.dtype input.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_device_metadata(input: torch.device)
methods.description: Creates metadata dictionary for torch.device input.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] extract_layout_metadata(input: torch.layout)
methods.description: Creates metadata dictionary for torch.layout input.

methods.name: str aoti_compile_with_persistent_cache( ns: str, op_func_name_with_overload: str, device_type: str, dynamic: bool, f: Callable[..., Any], args: tuple[Any], kwargs: dict[str, Any], *, dynamic_shapes: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, options: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, remove_runtime_assertions: bool = False, disable_constraint_solver: bool = False, )
methods.description: Compiles a function with caching of the generated kernel and associated metadata, supporting static shape tensors.
